caption: The drawing depicts a decorative clock with a round face featuring black Roman numerals on a white background, and black clock hands. The clock face sits within a gold-colored bezel, and beneath it, the body of the clock is shaped like a lyre with ornate, curling, symmetrical scrollwork at the base, decorated with green and pink leaf patterns. The central area below the clock face is red with thin gold stripes. The entire clock body is primarily brown with gold accents. Topping the clock is a sculpture of a dark brown or bronze-colored eagle with outstretched wings, perched above the clock face. The base of the clock is rectangular with a mirrored or pale gray panel framed in brown wood. The background of the drawing is light beige with no additional objects or patterns. The artist name "SOVENSKY" appears in the lower left corner.
title: Lyre Clock
